name: VNDC
oneLiner: VNDC is Jade Labs's VND-denominated token, now disclosed as VNDC 2.0 backed by USDT/USDC pools under issuer and investigation risk.

obituary.epitaph: Criminal case ended the ONUS issuer
obituary.obituary: Vietnam's Ministry of Public Security opened a criminal case on 2026-03-23 against the founders and operators of the ONUS exchange, who created and sold VNDC, ONUS and HNG to investors. The issuer platform goonus.io now returns HTTP 404 and vndc.io serves an unrelated site, leaving no published redemption channel.
obituary.sourceLabel: Ministry of Public Security ONUS/VNDC case announcement, 2026-03-26

collateral: Issuer-disclosed VNDC 2.0 USDT/USDC smart-contract collateral on Polygon and BNB Smart Chain; reserve and redemption claims remain high-risk after the March 2026 ONUS/VNDC investigation
pegMechanism: Issuer-controlled mint and redemption through ONUS/VNDC Hub; VNDC 2.0 disclosures describe USDT/USDC collateral pools rather than direct VND bank reserves, with redemption reliability impaired by the March 2026 criminal investigation

proofOfReserves.provider: Jade Labs / VNDC issuer disclosure (vndc.io origin unreachable, HTTP 521 on repeated checks 2026-08-08; on 2026-10-19 vndc.io redirected to an unrelated 'SPE PVTS Packing Video Tracking System' login page; no reserve artefact verifiable)

notices.title: Vietnam criminal investigation
notices.message: Vietnamese authorities arrested ONUS/VNDC-linked executives in March 2026 in a fraud and money-laundering investigation involving VNDC, ONUS, and related tokens. The Ministry of Public Security alleges that the bank deposits advertised as backing VNDC 1:1 were never made, so VNDC redemption and reserve claims should be treated as high risk.

notices.title: Market cap and supply inconsistency
notices.message: Aggregator-reported market cap (~$50M) does not consistently match on-chain Polygon/BSC supply, and reserves are self-disclosed by Jade Labs without an independent audit cadence.

notices.title: Curated reserves are self-reported
notices.message: The curated-validated live-reserves adapter points at the Jade Labs / VNDC issuer website because no third-party attestation page has been verified. Reserve composition reflects the issuer's own disclosure only until an independent auditor or proof-of-reserves feed is published.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: VNDC 2.0 is an issuer-controlled reserve token described as backed by USDT and USDC collateral pools.
